payload.title: K. Local sentiment classifier
payload.description:
Purpose: add a LOCAL (no cloud APIs) sentiment classifier for human user messages as a second packaged metric alongside thanks vs. F-bombs. Per-message compound score (-1..+1) plus pos/neu/neg labels, aggregated per window and per source in the meter report.

Scope: (a) VADER backend via the vader-sentiment npm package (offline port) run on the same code/quote/paste-stripped text the counter uses; (b) coding-domain lexicon overrides so technical usage of kill/error/fail/bug/crash/abort/exception is not negative; (c) meter aggregation (mean compound, pos/neu/neg counts) wired into CLI text and JSON; (d) a synthetic gold set modeled on coding-chat patterns plus an accuracy eval; (e) an optional Transformers.js backend behind a flag with a small local ONNX model, cached locally, compared against VADER on the gold set and a real-corpus agreement check (aggregate numbers only); (f) docs and tests.

Done when: VADER and transformer backends both run locally on BlackbookM1 with throughput measured; gold accuracy reported; meter output carries the new counts only; privacy rules apply identically (no message text persisted anywhere).
